# chameleon_principal_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a principal role to a Polaris principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chameleon_principal" "etl" {
  name = "etl-pipeline"
  type = "SERVICE"
}

resource "chameleon_principal_role" "data_reader" {
  name = "data_reader"
}

resource "chameleon_principal_role_assignment" "etl_reader" {
  principal = chameleon_principal.etl.name
  role      = chameleon_principal_role.data_reader.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal` (String) Principal name to assign the role to.
- `role` (String) Principal role name to assign.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `<principal>/<role>`.
